prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, high-resolution image of a hand delicately lifting a single round cotton pad from a white plastic container filled with neatly stacked cotton pads. The scene is shot from a slightly elevated angle, focusing on the gentle motion of the hand and the soft, textured surface of the cotton pad. The lighting is bright and diffused, creating a clean, clinical atmosphere with minimal shadows and a cool, neutral color palette dominated by whites and soft grays. The background is out of focus, emphasizing the crisp details of the cotton pads and the subtle translucency of the hand and tweezers. The overall style is minimalist and modern, evoking a sense of hygiene, purity, and precision, with a shallow depth of field that draws attention to the tactile quality of the materials.
